scope: one fixed 8x64-token Soup training window, current two-read L2L vs opt-in route-preserving MBR; one update per measured arm; not quality or physical-SSD evidence

host_preflight.note: Mount source is reported for inspection; this script does not claim it is a physical NVMe device.

notes: Both arms use the current Soup L2LStep with two_read_experts=True and grouped_expert_routes=True.
Only the MBR arm groups routed expert FFN work across microbatches; attention and routing remain per microbatch.
The MBR group-size sweep uses the same total 8x64-token input window in every run.
Group size 1 is a no-cross-microbatch MBR-path control; it still exercises the route-preserving wrapper.
A RAM ballast may reserve cgroup headroom, but does not change memory.max and is not strict P3 host qualification.
Runtime expert bytes and process read_bytes are logical/process counters, not SSD-controller telemetry.
Diagnostic route capture and phase counter collection use separate runs outside the reported A-B-B-A timing samples.
